research.title: Integrated Vehicle Motion Control
research.label: VEHICLE DYNAMICS × CONTROL
research.description: Coordinating steering, braking, driving, and suspension to shape vehicle motion.
research.detail: We investigate how multiple chassis actuators can work together to improve handling, stability, comfort, and energy efficiency. Modeling, state estimation, and control allocation connect vehicle-level objectives to actuator-level motion.
questions: How can multiple actuators deliver a coherent vehicle response?
How should handling, comfort, and efficiency be balanced under constraints?

research.title: X-by-Wire & Electrified Chassis
research.label: MECHATRONICS × ELECTRIFICATION
research.description: Precise and reliable control of the next generation of chassis actuators.
research.detail: Our work spans steer-by-wire, brake-by-wire, 48 V e-steering, and e-Corner actuation. We study robust motion control, motor synchronization, steering feel, and fault-tolerant control for electrified mobility.
questions: How can steering and braking remain precise under disturbances?
How can redundant actuators be coordinated reliably?

research.title: AI-Based Modeling & State Estimation
research.label: PHYSICS × LEARNING
research.description: Combining physical insight and data to understand complex motion systems.
research.detail: We combine physical models, observations, and learning algorithms to estimate vehicle and actuator states. Research topics include tire-force estimation, friction modeling, fault detection, and data-driven control.
questions: How can physical structure make learning more useful for control?
How can vehicle states be inferred from limited measurements?

research.title: Teleoperation & Future Mobility
research.label: HUMAN × MACHINE × MOBILITY
research.description: Connecting human intent and intelligent control across new mobility platforms.
research.detail: We investigate remote driving, human–machine interaction, tilting mobility, and autonomous mobile robots. Network-aware control, feedback design, mechanism development, and motion planning support these platforms.
questions: How can remote control remain intuitive despite network delay?
How can new mechanisms enable agile and accessible mobility?

researchPrograms.title: Vehicle Dynamics and Integrated Motion Control
researchPrograms.description: Research on modeling, analysis, and control of dynamic vehicle behavior. Develops advanced algorithms to optimize stability, handling, and ride comfort. Enhances overall vehicle safety and driving performance.

researchPrograms.title: Mechatronics for Future e-Mobility
researchPrograms.description: Integration of advanced mechatronic systems for electrified mobility platforms. Focuses on developing intelligent actuators and control algorithms for enhanced vehicle efficiency and performance.
